_comment: Per-finding suppression. Keyed by the stable finding id (check + file + subject),
so suppressing one instance can never hide a new one from the same check.
Every entry requires a reason — an unexplained suppression is indistinguishable
from a bug being swept under the rug.
Review these whenever the underlying files change substantially.

suppressed.f4b0458edb: B5 — PROJECT_CONTEXT.md §2 (Stacks) is read as prose by every stage ('target stack per PROJECT_CONTEXT.md') rather than cited as '§2'. Intentional: it is narrative context, not an obligation target.
suppressed.63683ca1ac: D3 — AGENTS_TEMPLATE.md is the invariants file. High imperative density is its entire purpose, so being a set-median outlier is by design, not emphasis inflation.
